overall_assessment: The Conductor framework architecture and linked context assets codified across conductor/upstream.lock.json, scripts/install-conductor.sh, scripts/install-conductor.ps1, conductor/index.md, conductor/product.md, conductor/product-guidelines.md, conductor/tech-stack.md, conductor/workflow.md, conductor/requirements.md, conductor/design.md, scripts/conductor_status.py, tests/test_conductor_status.py, and tests/test_foundation_toolchain_governance.py establish a robust, deterministic, and auditable foundation for Searchright. The upstream Conductor lockfile (conductor/upstream.lock.json) locks baseline 0.3.0 with exact commit and installer metadata, while scripts/install-conductor.sh and install-conductor.ps1 provide reproducible, cross-platform installation entrypoints. The Conductor markdown context spine provides comprehensive product vision, architecture, guidelines, workflow constraints, requirements, and design boundaries that resolve cleanly under scripts/check_context_integrity.py. The native read-only v3 status adapter (scripts/conductor_status.py) reconciles track registry, execution plans, evidence ledgers, and in-place archives safely without executing inspected-root code or mutating repository state. Adversarial tests in tests/test_conductor_status.py thoroughly probe track discovery, malformed YAML/JSON payloads, status drift, and integrity verification network-free. Governance unit tests in tests/test_foundation_toolchain_governance.py pass 100% network-free.

findings.description: Host environment Conductor version (0.4.1 in Gemini CLI) differs from pinned repository baseline (0.3.0 in conductor/upstream.lock.json), though compatibility and reconciliation are formally documented and verified.
findings.recommendation: Preserve 0.3.0 baseline compatibility checks in static harness while supporting host 0.4.1 runtime.

findings.description: The native status adapter scripts/conductor_status.py operates in strict read-only mode, preventing hostile or untrusted track definitions from executing arbitrary code during repository validation.
findings.recommendation: Maintain strict AST / data parsing in conductor_status.py without external shell invocation.
